question: Which of the following rivers originates from the Naag Pahadi Ajmer district of Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Luni River**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​__****Luni river**:

 
 
• ​Luni river originates from **Nag Pahar or Naga Hills** located in the** Ajmer district of Rajasthan**.
 
• The Luni is the **largest river** in the **Thar Desert **of northwest India.
 
• It originates in the** Pushkar valley of the Aravalli Range**, near Ajmer, and passes through the southeastern portion of the Thar Desert.
 
• The mouth of Luni is the marshy lands of **Rann of Kutch in Gujarat**.
 
• It flows through** Ajmer, Barmer, and Jalore. Jodhpur, Nagaur, Pali and Sirohi districts of Rajasthan**.
